description: Java class for sending emails within the Thingsboard rule engine, handling SMTP configuration and message processing.

classes.name: TbSendEmailNode
classes.description: A node in the Thingsboard rule engine responsible for sending emails via SMTP, with configurable SMTP settings and message validation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, setting up SMTP sender if custom settings are used.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, validates type, extracts email data, and sends email asynchronously.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends email using either system SMTP settings or custom SMTP configuration.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Deserializes message data into TbEmail object and validates recipient address.

methods.name: validateType
methods.description: Checks if message type is SEND_EMAIL, logs warning and throws exception if not.

methods.name: createMailSender
methods.description: Creates and configures JavaMailSenderImpl with SMTP settings.

methods.name: createJavaMailProperties
methods.description: Builds JavaMail properties object based on SMTP configuration, including protocol, host, port, TLS, proxy, etc.
